Part.name: Relikt ERA cassette
Part.description: Placeable heavy reactive armour. One cassette reacts once against eligible HEAT or APFSDS hits, then its cover disappears to show the empty mount. Return to Edit to restore it. Relikt-inspired gameplay model: fixed 500 × 300 × 96 mm and about 53.9 kg. First-version damage proxy retains passive resistance and mass after firing; no tandem-warhead simulation.
